content: प्रस्था €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> ²1 To set out, depart; पारसीकांस्ततो जेतुं प्रतस्थे स्थलवर्त्मना <ls>R. 4. 60</ls>; <ls>Ku. 3. 22</ls>. .²2 To advance, march towards. .²3 To walk, move; प्रस्थितायां प्रतिष्ठेथाः <ls>R. 1. 89</ls>. .²4 To stand firmly. .²5 To be established. .²6 To approach, come near. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To cause to retire. .²2 To send away, dismiss, despatch; तौ दम्पती स्वां प्रति राजधानीं प्रस्थापयामास वशी वशिष्ठः <ls>R. 2. 70</ls>. .²2 To drive away, banish, expel; अधः प्रस्थापिताश्वेन <ls>Ku. 6. 7</ls>. .²4 To urge forward, push on.
